name: Psy
description:
'''Park Jae-sang''' ({{korean/auto|hangul=박재상|ko_ipa=pɐk̚.t͡ɕεsɐŋ}}; born December 31, 1977), better known as '''Psy''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|s|aɪ}} {{respell|SY}}; {{korean|싸이|labels=no}}), is a South Korean rapper, singer, songwriter, and record producer. He has received [[List of awards and nominations received by Psy|numerous accolades]], including an [[American Music Awards|American Music Award]], a [[World Music Awards|World Music Award]], 10 [[MAMA Awards]]. He is the founder of the talent agency [[P Nation]].

Psy released his debut studio album ''[[Psy from the Psycho World!]]'' in 2001. He gained international prominence in 2012 with the hit single "[[Gangnam Style]]", which reached the top 10 on the U.S. [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] and became a global [[viral video|viral phenomenon]]. [[Gangnam Style (music video)|Its music video]] was the first on [[YouTube]] to reach 1 billion views; it held the record for [[List of most-viewed YouTube videos|most-viewed YouTube video]] from November 2012 to July 2017. Psy's followup, 2013's "[[Gentleman (Psy song)|Gentleman]]", also reached the top 10 of the Hot 100 and its video set a new record for YouTube views in its first 24 hours.

He is a recipient of the [[Order of Cultural Merit (Korea)|Okgwan (4th Class) Order of Cultural Merit]].
